selection_reason: GDKVM uses spatiotemporal key-value memory and gated delta-rule updates to retain video context with linear-time inference; this recurrent memory mechanism is transferable to efficient sequence-state handling, although the evaluation is echocardiography segmentation.
title: GDKVM: Echocardiography Video Segmentation via Spatiotemporal Key-Value Memory with Gated Delta Rule
